video.description: A closed vertical hardcover book stands on a dark Gothic desk. For the first 3 seconds it remains still, atmospheric candlelight softly tracing the spine outline, mysterious and silent. Then at 3 seconds the book slowly opens vertically — the front cover and back cover spread apart like a theater stage opening. From the center, the first layer of heavy cardstock paper curtain unfurls outward to both sides, rising up to reveal a moonlit Forbidden Forest paper-cut diorama: layered paper clouds, paper tree branches, and a folded-paper owl perched on a branch. Cold blue backlight activates from behind the paper layers, silver-white glowing halos appear around every cut edge. Camera begins a slow smooth dolly-in push toward the first layer surface, approaching the paper owl. By end the owl is close and ready to take flight, cold blue light blazing.

Paper scroll smoke billows and fills the second layer. The second layer paper curtain begins to peel open from the center — each side curling outward softly like a theater drape. Through the parting gap the warm yellow tone transitions to fierce intense gold as the third layer Quidditch pitch emerges: ring-shaped stadium stands in receding parallel cardstock planes, a Seeker figure on a broomstick silhouette diving at center, and a Golden Snitch as a bright cut-out orb. Camera pushes in through the parting second layer. In second half, camera fully inside third layer: ring stands create deep paper perspective, Seeker dives with laser-cut paper strip tail feathers, Golden Snitch spins and rotates rapidly, warm gold backlight from behind stands blazes like stage spotlights creating dramatic silhouette contrast. Camera continues push-in through a paper goal hoop. End: Snitch bursts into an explosion of golden paper fragments and shards flying toward the camera lens.

Golden paper fragments float suspended in warm light, slowly drifting down. The third layer paper curtain peels open from center to both sides. Fourth layer Great Hall glows behind it with warm amber candlelight: long dining tables recede in paper perspective, hollow cut-out candle flames are backlit amber creating glow-through fire effects, paper stars hang from a vaulted ceiling. Camera enters and weaves between the long tables. Then the scene rapidly shifts within the same layer: tables and candles fold down and a baroque mirror frame rises (Mirror of Erised) with warm light casting a vague human silhouette inside it, then the mirror folds away and a Potions classroom rises with jewel-toned translucent flask silhouettes. Then all elements reverse-unfold flat and shatter into gold-white paper fragments. Fragments are pulled into a spiral vortex aimed at camera. Layer becomes transparent, vortex center glows faintly.

The paper owl on the branch launches into flight — rigid angular paper wings fan open and begin beating, trailing silver paper dust particles. The first paper layer curtain (paper trees and clouds) gently peels apart from the center, each side rolling softly outward like a theater drape, the paper becoming increasingly transparent. Through the widening gap, warm amber-yellow backlight seeps in from the second layer behind — a Gothic arched colonnade station platform with a cardstock steam locomotive beginning to glow. Camera continues smooth push-in through the parting first layer. In the second half, camera fully enters second layer depth: Gothic arched colonnade silhouettes recede in perspective, cardstock locomotive at center with warm yellow light pouring from cut-out windows, human silhouettes with luggage walking toward the train, remnant paper clouds at foreground edges for depth. Camera advances toward the locomotive. End: locomotive chimney billows dense paper-scroll smoke with warm yellow light halos.

The paper vortex slowly disperses and dissolves. The fourth layer paper curtain peels open to both sides, light shifting to cold blue-silver. Fifth layer deep Forbidden Forest emerges: tall tree trunk silhouettes as heavy cardstock planes receding back into depth, cold blue backlight behind each tree layer, eerie shadow-theater atmosphere. Paper web silhouettes and paper spider shapes at foreground. Camera pushes in through the cold forest. Then a folded-paper stag (Patronus) charges out from the mid-layer — silver-white backlight blazes from within its paper body like a paper lantern. The stag crashes through the foreground paper web, web fragments scatter in cold light. Stag continues charging powerfully toward the camera, silver-white glow outline blazing against deep midnight blue. End: stag's paper form fractures into hundreds of small white paper cranes at its edges, the flock launching outward toward camera and dispersing.

White paper cranes scatter and spread apart. The fifth layer paper curtain peels open from center revealing the deepest innermost layer: a grand Hogwarts Castle panorama as massive layered cardstock silhouettes — castle towers, the Forbidden Forest, the Black Lake all as receding parallel paper planes. Farthest back: fierce warm gold morning backlight blazing, casting the entire castle as an epic theatrical silhouette. Camera briefly holds on this magnificent deepest layer view. Paper cranes fly over the castle turrets. Then camera smoothly begins a slow pull-back — moving backward through each layer as the paper curtains draw closed from innermost outward: the fifth layer forest curtain closes from both sides, then fourth layer closes, third closes, second closes, first closes — each like a theater curtain gently drawing shut. Finally the book's front and back covers fold together and the book closes completely vertical. The closed cover emits a single warm gold pulse of light, then fades to darkness matching the opening frame.

video.description: A closed vertical hardcover book with 'Harry Potter' gold lettering on the dark crimson cover stands on a dark Gothic wooden desk. The book begins to open from right to left — the front cover swings leftward (right-to-left page turn), spine stays fixed, cover rotates to the left revealing the interior. From inside, the first heavy cardstock paper curtain unfurls outward to both sides like a theater stage opening, rising to reveal a moonlit Forbidden Forest paper-cut diorama: layered paper clouds, bare tree branches, a folded-paper white owl perched on a branch. Cold icy blue backlight activates from behind the paper layers, silver-white glowing halos on every cut paper edge. Camera slowly pushes in from outside the book toward the first paper layer. Final frame: the paper owl centered, cold blue backlight blazing behind layered forest silhouettes — matching the moonlit Forbidden Forest diorama view.

Inside a vertical tunnel book paper-cut light box diorama. The scene shows photorealistic heavy cardstock silhouette elements: the warm amber Great Hall long tables and cut-out candle flames slowly fold downward and compress flat, their paper fiber texture and laser-cut edges visible throughout. The Mirror of Erised rises as a precise baroque mirror frame cut-out in thick cardstock, warm amber light shining through the hollow mirror opening casting a vague human silhouette shape inside — the mirror feels like an intricate paper lantern, not a cartoon. Then the Potions classroom shelving rises with glass flask shapes as richly colored translucent cut-paper panels backlit in jewel tones, each flask a carefully laser-cut cardstock form with visible edge thickness and layered depth. All elements have real physical paper fiber texture, cast shadows between layers, and backlit glow halos — no cartoon lines, no flat illustration style. Then all the paper elements reverse-unfold flat and shatter into micro-cut paper confetti fragments in gold and white, the fragments spiraling inward into a clockwise vortex aimed at the camera. The vortex tightens to a glowing pinpoint at center. Final frame matches exactly: a tight spiral of paper scraps and confetti spinning inward, warm amber tones, real physical paper texture throughout.

Long dining tables recede in layered cardstock perspective, hollow cut-out candle flame shapes backlit with warm amber light glowing through the negative space, paper stars suspended from a vaulted ceiling silhouette. All surfaces show real physical cardstock fiber texture and visible laser-cut edge thickness. Camera weaves slowly between the long tables. Then the Great Hall paper elements fold and compress. The Mirror of Erised rises as a thick cardstock baroque frame — the mirror opening is a hollow cut-out with warm backlight glowing through it, casting a soft vague human silhouette shape. The frame has visible cardstock thickness, pressed ornamental detail in the paper surface, real shadow cast between layers — it is a paper craft object, not a cartoon drawing. Then Potions classroom shelving rises: glass flasks are translucent colored paper panels laser-cut in flask shapes, each with visible edge thickness, layered depth, and jewel-toned backlight glowing through the cut paper — they look like stained glass paper lanterns, not flat colored cartoons. # Harry Potter Paper-Cut Light Box — 48-Second Tunnel Book Film

## Concept
A 48-second cinematic loop built around a vertical tunnel book aesthetic. A real standing book opens once, reveals 5 layers of paper-cut diorama worlds, then closes. Each layer is a Harry Potter scene rendered in thick cardstock silhouettes with independent backlighting — warm gold, cold blue, amber — creating a shadow-box theater of depth and light. Six 8-second clips are stitched seamlessly via shared first/last frames. No text. No voiceover. Pure visual poetry.

## Visual Language
- **Medium**: Paper-cut light box / shadow box / vertical tunnel book
- **Layers**: 5–6 parallel heavy cardstock silhouette planes, 3–5 cm apart
- **Lighting**: Independent backlight behind each layer; warm gold (amber) in inner layers, cold blue/silver in outer layers
- **Edges**: Laser-cut edges glow with backlight halos — visible paper fiber texture, physical cut thickness
- **Subjects**: All figures, animals, buildings rendered as flat cut silhouettes, depth created by layering
- **Transitions**: Each scene change = paper curtain peeling open to both sides like a theater drape, revealing the next layer's backlight glow. No hard cuts. No black. No page turns.
- **Camera**: Continuous dolly-in / push-in through layers; final reversal pull-back through all 5 layers closing the book

## Color Arc
- Outer (Clip 1–2): Cold blue, silver-white, midnight blue — moonlit forest
- Mid (Clip 3–4): Warm gold, amber, candlelight — train platform, Quidditch pitch, Great Hall
- Deep (Clip 5–6): Cold blue → warm gold → dark cover return

## Scenes

### Clip 1 — Book Opening → Forbidden Forest Layer 1 (00:00–00:08)
**First frame**: Closed standing book (@Image1), dark Gothic desk, candlelight rim-lighting the spine.
**00:00–00:03**: Vertical book on dark desk, cover facing forward, atmosphere dim and mysterious. Only ambient light traces the spine.
**00:03–00:08**: Book opens vertically — front and back cover spread apart like a diorama stage opening. First cardstock curtain unfurls from center outward. Moonlit Forbidden Forest emerges: layered paper clouds, paper tree branches, a folded-paper owl perched on a branch. Cold blue backlight illuminates from behind; silver-white glow halos the cloud and branch edges. Camera slowly pushes in toward layer 1 surface.
**Last frame**: Owl poised to take flight, cold blue backlight, paper edges glowing (@Image2).

### Clip 2 — Through Layer 1 → Platform Nine-and-Three-Quarters (00:08–00:16)
**First frame**: @Image2 — Owl on branch, cold blue glow.
**00:08–00:12**: Paper owl launches from branch, rigid paper wings fanning, trailing silver paper dust. First layer paper curtain gently peels open to both sides — paper trees and clouds grow transparent, warm yellow backlight seeps through the parting gap, second layer Nine-and-Three-Quarters platform glowing behind.
**00:12–00:16**: Camera fully enters second layer depth. Gothic arched colonnade silhouettes recede in perspective. Cardstock steam locomotive at mid-layer, warm yellow light pouring from cut-out windows and arches. Human silhouettes with luggage walk toward train. Remnant paper clouds from layer 1 float at foreground edges, reinforcing depth.
**Last frame**: Locomotive chimney billowing dense paper-scroll smoke, warm yellow light halos the smoke edges (@Image3).

### Clip 3 — Through Layer 2 → Quidditch Pitch (00:16–00:24)
**First frame**: @Image3 — Locomotive with paper smoke, warm amber glow.
**00:16–00:20**: Paper smoke fills layer 2. Second layer curtain peels open. Warm yellow transitions to fierce gold. Quidditch pitch emerges: ring-shaped stands receding in layers, Seeker silhouettes on brooms at mid-layer, Golden Snitch as a glowing cut-out paper orb. Camera pushes in.
**00:20–00:24**: Camera fully inside third layer. Ring stands in deep paper perspective. Seeker on paper broom dives, tail feathers rendered as laser-cut paper strips. Golden Snitch spins at high speed. Warm gold backlight from stands acts like stage spotlights. Camera continues push-in through paper goal hoops.
**Last frame**: Golden Snitch explodes into thousands of golden paper fragments flying toward lens (@Image4).

### Clip 4 — Through Layer 3 → Great Hall Montage (00:24–00:32)
**First frame**: @Image4 — Gold paper fragments suspended, gold light.
**00:24–00:28**: Gold paper fragments float and fall. Third layer curtain peels open. Fourth layer Great Hall glows with warm amber candlelight. Long tables recede in paper perspective; cut-out candle flames backlit amber through hollow silhouettes; paper stars hang from vaulted ceiling. Camera weaves between long tables.
**00:28–00:30**: Within same layer, scene shifts rapidly — long tables and candles fold down; Mirror of Erised rises (baroque mirror frame cut-out, warm light casting vague human silhouette within mirror); mirror folds away; Potions classroom rises (glass flasks as colored translucent cut-out paper, backlit in jewel tones).
**00:30–00:32**: All Potions elements reverse-unfold to flat plane, shatter into gold-and-white paper fragments, fragments sucked into a vortex pointing toward camera. Layer becomes transparent.
**Last frame**: Vortex of paper fragments at center, spiraling inward, faint light at vortex core (@Image5).

### Clip 5 — Through Layer 4 → Forbidden Forest Patronus (00:32–00:40)
**First frame**: @Image5 — Paper fragment vortex, cold light returning.
**00:32–00:36**: Vortex of fragments disperses. Fourth layer curtain peels open. Light shifts to cold blue-silver. Fifth layer deep Forbidden Forest glows: tall tree silhouettes recede in layers, cold blue backlight behind each trunk, eerie shadow-theater atmosphere. Paper web and paper spider silhouettes at foreground.
**00:36–00:40**: A folded-paper stag (Patronus) charges from mid-layer, silver-white backlight blazing from within its paper body. It crashes through foreground paper web; web fragments scatter in cold light. Stag continues charging toward camera, silver-white outline blazing like moonlight against deep blue.
**Last frame**: Stag shatters into hundreds of white paper cranes, flock launching toward camera then dispersing (@Image6).

### Clip 6 — Through Layer 5 → Hogwarts + All Layers Close (00:40–00:48)
**First frame**: @Image6 — Paper cranes dispersing, cold blue turning warm.
**00:40–00:43**: Paper cranes scatter. Fifth layer curtain peels open, revealing the deepest layer: Hogwarts Castle panorama. Castle towers, Forbidden Forest, Black Lake all rendered as massive layered cardstock silhouettes. Farthest back: fierce warm gold morning-light backlight, casting the entire castle as an epic silhouette. Camera lingers. Paper cranes fly over castle turrets.
**00:43–00:48**: Camera reverses — slow pull-back. Layer by layer, paper curtains close from innermost out: Layer 5 (Forbidden Forest) draws shut from both sides, Layer 4 (Great Hall) draws shut, Layer 3 (Quidditch) draws shut, Layer 2 (Platform) draws shut, Layer 1 (Forest) draws shut — each like a theater curtain closing. Book closes vertically, front and back covers fold together. Cover (@Image1) emits one warm gold pulse from gilded title, then fades to darkness. Final frame is identical to 00:00 opening frame — perfect loop.

## Music
48-second continuous orchestral score, no voice interference.
- **00:00–00:08**: Clear piano + strings, moonlit breeze, underscores book opening
- **00:08–00:16**: Warm light enters — viola + harp, rises with platform glow
- **00:16–00:24**: Fierce brass + timpani, golden energy with Quidditch push
- **00:24–00:30**: Warm woodwind + harpsichord, baroque warmth through Great Hall montage
- **00:30–00:40**: Full orchestra, epic sweep through forest and castle
- **00:40–00:48**: Decelerates — cello sustain + clear piano, paper curtains close one by one, volume fades to silence

**Music accent hits**: 3s (book opens), 10s (pass layer 1), 18s (pass layer 2), 26s (montage), 34s (pass layer 4), 42s (deepest layer), 45s (close begins)

## Sound Design
Book opening creak (thick cardboard friction), curtain peel (soft paper slide), owl wings (rigid paper fan), train steam (paper roll hiss), Snitch burst (paper ball pop + fragment flutter), layer transitions (continuous paper friction), stag charge (paper web shatter), paper crane flock (multi-layer cardboard wing chorus), book close (thick cardboard thud). All SFX mixed beneath music, never masking melody.

## Technical Requirements
- No text, letters, numbers, symbols, or subtitles anywhere in the video
- No voiceover
- Book stands vertical throughout; opens once at 00:00, closes once at 00:48
- All 6 clips connected via shared first/last frames (Clip N last = Clip N+1 first)
- Clip 1 first frame and Clip 6 last frame = @Image1 (perfect loop)
- Paper-cut light box aesthetic throughout: multi-layer cardstock silhouettes, independent backlighting per layer, physical paper texture and cut-edge depth
- Scene transitions via "paper curtain parting" — never hard cuts, never black screen
- Photorealistic paper craft quality: real cardstock volume, real backlight glow, real cast shadows, believable layered depth
